name: Arcane Feedback
summary: In Darnassus, Arcane Feedback sends human priests back to Stormwind. Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon reluctantly honors the Alliance summons. There, High Priestess Laurena prepares the acolyte for deeper instruction.

sections.title: A Reluctant Summons
sections.body: Priestess Alathea oversees visiting priests in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She recognizes the formal alliance between the kaldorei and Stormwind, yet distrusts human magical and spiritual practices. Night elves see arcane power as volatile and dangerous, a view shaped by ten millennia of grief since the War of the Ancients. Even human divine rites trouble the night elf clergy when they blur radiant faith with arcane workings.

sections.title: Return to the Cathedral
sections.body: Alathea honors the bond between the Alliance races and sends you to answer a recall from the Cathedral of Light. High Priestess Laurena has sent couriers across the seas to gather human priests for advanced training. In Stormwind, you leave Elune's moonlit groves behind for the grand stone sanctuaries and golden radiance of the Holy Light.

faq.q: Why does Priestess Alathea want me to leave Darnassus?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea sends you home at the request of your superiors in Stormwind, though human theology also makes her uneasy. She distrusts arcane magic, even when tied to divine practice, and is glad to send human acolytes back to their own cathedrals.

faq.q: Why do night elves distrust human priestly magic?
faq.answer: Night elves distrust human priestly magic because their culture bears the grief of the Sundering, caused by reckless arcane spellcraft ten thousand years ago. Kaldorei worship centers on Elune, and its priestesses mistrust traditions that border on or use arcane power, even among allies who follow the Holy Light.
High Priestess Laurena leads the faithful at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. She trains emerging human priests in the Holy Light as their power grows.

faq.q: What does this quest lead into?
faq.answer: Reporting to High Priestess Laurena begins your advanced training as a human priest in Stormwind, where you learn the discipline and blessings of human adherents of the Holy Light.

angles.text: As a priest, your return marks a threshold in your spiritual path and reveals the sharp divide between Elune's sisterhood and the teachings of the Holy Light.
As a human, you return to Stormwind, home of the Church of the Holy Light, after leaving the cloistered, skeptical kaldorei priesthood.
As a night elf, you see Priestess Alathea's wariness reflect the kaldorei fear that arcane tampering by younger mortal races could bring another disaster.
